fields.acceptance: go test ./internal/api -run 'TestModelBranch' with a local bare origin and a fake gh: an accept in the main checkout yields a pushed model/<cs>-<entry> branch from origin/main holding exactly that entry and one PR request; a --record apply yields a branch holding its entry plus the re-rendered .rhiza/rendered/ files, on which rhiza check passes with no stale-render problem; a second write to the same change set adds a commit to the same branch and opens no second PR; the temporary worktree is removed; a dry run pushes nothing
fields.statement: A model write made in the main checkout for a change set with no live run still writes its entry into the main checkout's .rhiza/log and, in the same operation, commits it onto the short-lived branch model/<change set>-<entry>, named with the full change set and entry IDs, cut from origin/main in a temporary worktree, pushes it and opens a model-only PR; when the write changes the landed model (a --record apply or link, an add actor --record, an answer or accept that lands a record), the commit also carries rhiza render's output for .rhiza/rendered/ so the PR passes make check's self-check; a later write to the same change set while its model PR is open goes onto that same branch and PR
